For partial, include only page, status, and spans when some visible text is reliably legible and some is uncertain. Give 2 to 64 ordered spans with both kinds. Use one marker for each uninterrupted uncertain run. Do not join known text across an uncertain run or fill a gap from context. Each known span must contain non-whitespace text. Transcribed text or combined known text may use at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes. Preserve visible wording, order, and spacing. No extra fields, confidence, code fences, or commentary.
